having a phone call appointment from the gp all I can say is wow… my appointment was regarding a referral letter for an xray at a private hospital. Taking pressure off the NHS I thought this would be appreciated. I’m a victim of domestic violence and a result of this I need an xray on my nose as the NHS couldn’t determine whether it was broken or not. DR was aware of my situation and what I’ve been through as I told her over the phone and would’ve had my notes up in-front of her. I’m also 99% sure she was the GP who  attempted to refer me to the ENT after the attack (GP wasn’t able to refer me I needed to go to A\u0026E) After explaining I needed a referral letter today instead of 3 days time like she suggested she proceeded to burst out laughing and said “you will get in a lot of trouble for this lovely girl”. As you can imagine this was extremely triggering for me, having someone of that level of profession sit over the phone and laugh at me for something so simple? I had a referral letter back in October that I was able to pick up the day off so you can imagine my confusion when I was now told I needed to wait 3 days? As a victim of domestic abuse I can’t begin to explain to you have degrading and belittling it is to have someone laugh at you about the situation. As a female GP also I thought she would’ve had some sort of understanding of the subject and maybe have a little sympathy?? After I explained I didn’t appreciate the laughter she then went on to say (3 times may I add) “do I understand how painful the surgery is” “do I understand the severity of it” after being the bigger person and ignoring these condescending comments I finally had to snap back and explain to her it’s not something I have chosen to do myself, it’s something that has to be done to correct an injury of an attack that was unprovoked. No pain will ever compare to the mental, emotional and physical trauma that I’ve carried the last few months. I’m not one to ever complain, i’m a young woman with a lot going on at the moment the last thing I need to be doing is writing a complaint. I hope this review is taken into consideration and makes the  DR  think twice about her responses in the future especially when dealing with such sensitive topics. I thought having a rhinoplasty done privately would take massive pressure of the NHS, when I do need to use them I’m greeted with the stigma that surrounds them constantly. I’ve gone to this GP for 22 years, all my life!! Never, and I mean never have I been treated this poorly. Disgusted doesn’t cover it, any man or women that has or is suffering  with domestic violence I would suggest doing your research before making an appointment here, as it seems to be a joke to them, or one DR in
